current_step.title: Active Directory SMB Share & User Enumeration
current_step.action: Enumerate domain password policy, null sessions, and readable SMB shares on 10.10.10.161
current_step.rationale: Discovered SMB (port 445) and/or LDAP (port 389) open on 10.10.10.161. Auditing anonymous/guest access, domain password policies, and accessible file shares.
current_step.expected_output: Domain policy, user list, and readable SMB shares (e.g. SYSVOL, NETLOGON, public).
current_step.risk_assessment: Low risk. Generates standard SMB SessionSetup and TreeConnect events in security event logs (Event ID 4624).

completed_steps.title: Network Port & Service Discovery
completed_steps.action: Execute Nmap service and OS detection scan against 10.10.10.161
completed_steps.purpose: Identify exposed services, open ports, and operating system signatures.
completed_steps.rationale: Target '10.10.10.161' is in scope, but no open port data has been ingested yet. Comprehensive port and service identification must be performed before specific exploits can be selected.
completed_steps.expected_output: List of open ports, daemon banners, OS signatures, and initial script findings.
completed_steps.risk_assessment: Standard SYN/TCP connect traffic. High volume port scanning may trigger firewall and IDS rate-limiting.
